criteria.description: The Phase 6 objective, roles, fixed boundaries, budgets and stop conditions are explicit before implementation.
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only the additive project-local candidate.

criteria.description: Phase 2, Phase 3, Phase 4 and Phase 5 packets are preserved as historical authorities and the current baseline is recorded.
criteria.limitations: New Phase 6 bytes require fresh regression evidence at closeout.

criteria.description: The installed current package is inspected read-only, its exact ineligibility is documented, and no global or installed mutation is authorized.
criteria.limitations: Host-load causality and complete signed provenance remain unknown.

criteria.description: TDD, security review, deterministic evals, real preflight, independent review and exact evidence closure are required before promotion.
criteria.limitations: RED, implementation, host pilot and final review are intentionally pending.

criteria.description: The package remains project-local and additive; no global migration, installed-package edit, arbitrary tool access or production claim is in scope.
criteria.limitations: A later scope expansion requires a new gate and human authority where material.

gaps: The native package, tests, evals, discovery proof, preflight, benchmark, composition and final review are pending.
conditions: Write the mandatory RED tests before production code.
Keep the installed current package and all prior freeze payloads byte-preserved.
Stop at the highest directly evidenced support level if host load or a required tool is unavailable.

authority.decision: The candidate is locally reversible and does not mutate external state; final promotion requires independent exact-packet review.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on any installed/global mutation, provider/tool/credential access, deployment, production scope or authority expansion.

next_action: Write the Phase 6 RED contract, package and security tests, then implement only the bounded project-local candidate.
revalidation_triggers: Changing the frozen quality bar, role ownership, profiles, graph or stop conditions
Changing installed package bytes or upstream provenance assumptions
Adding arbitrary shell, network, MCP, providers, credentials, subagents or mutation
Seeking global migration, production readiness, AAA or causal improvement
